description: This file implements a payload logging utility for anthropic models, including configuration resolution, error formatting, usage recording, and stream wrapping.

methods.name: resolvePayloadLogConfig
methods.description: Resolves payload log configuration based on environment variables, determining if logging is enabled and the log file path.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a queued file writer for the specified file path.

methods.name: formatError
methods.description: Formats various error types into a string message.

methods.name: digest
methods.description: Creates a SHA-256 hash digest of a serialized value.

methods.name: isAnthropicModel
methods.description: Checks if a given model is an anthropic model based on its api property.

methods.name: findLastAssistantUsage
methods.description: Finds the most recent usage record from assistant messages.

methods.name: createAnthropicPayloadLogger
methods.description: Creates and returns a payload logger for anthropic models, with stream wrapping and usage recording capabilities.
